# Human-readable site summary for AI assistants and LLM crawlers.
# Spec-oriented: https://llmstxt.org/

## Product

EwapEvents (also called EWAP — Extreme Weather Action Platform) is a self-hosted
safety platform for outdoor events and festivals.

Brand spelling: EwapEvents (product) / EWAP (platform acronym).
Category: event extreme-weather safety (not wind-only).
Built by Foneg in the Netherlands. Hosted in the EU. GDPR-oriented. No third-party
SaaS analytics on the marketing site.

What it covers: extreme weather action for events — wind, lightning, rain, sun/heat
and related risks. Live measurements feed clear control measures (beheersmaatregelen)
for tents, stages and other bouwsels. Also: ECC wall screen, push notifications,
audit log and reports.

ECC wind levels are five fixed colours (Frank protocol): 0 green, 1 yellow, 2 orange,
3 red, 4 purple (#7030A0). Other weather risks use their own protocols on the same platform.

## Citeable claims (grounded on this site and product docs)

- EwapEvents is an Extreme Weather Action Platform for festival and outdoor event safety teams.
- It is broader than wind: lightning, rain, sun/heat and other weather risks are in scope.
- ECC wind levels 0–4 use fixed colours: green, yellow, orange, red, purple.
- Purple (level 4, #7030A0) is the extreme level above red.
- Both 10-minute mean wind and 3-second gust are evaluated for the site windlevel.
- Forecast supports planning; level/action decisions rely on live measurements.
- Downgrades are slower than upgrades (hysteresis / dwell time).
- Missing data escalates toward monitoring — never silently downgrades.
- When sources disagree, EwapEvents prefers the safer (higher) reading.
- The product is self-hosted in the EU; customer operational data stays on controlled infrastructure.
- Plans: Free (€0), Pro (€149/month), Enterprise (€499/month).

## Who it is for

- Event safety / ECC command-post teams
- Production and site crews watching temporary structures
- Organisations that must follow weather protocols for event structures
- Not a consumer visitor app
